name: Semiconductor Hybrid Assembly, Inc.
old_description: We utilize our outstanding workforce and state-of-the-art facility to provide a multitude of services in the PCB and electronics manufacturing industry. We offer the following:
about:
Semiconductor Hybrid Assembly, Inc. (SHA) was founded in 1988 by Yassin Burgol in Wixom, Michigan. The family-owned business began with Ford Motor Company as its first customer, serving the metro Detroit area from an 800-square-foot building. Burgol was later joined by his wife Eva and sons Hisham and Ayman, and today three generations of the family operate the company.

SHA provides printed circuit board assembly services including surface-mount (SMT) and through-hole assembly, harness and test-box fabrication, conformal coating, electrical testing, rework, repair, and X-ray parts counting. The company operates a 16,000-square-foot facility with over 20 employees whose combined experience exceeds 400 years. Equipment includes Samsung SMD pick-and-place machines capable of 01005 and complex BGA placement, wave and selective soldering systems, automated optical inspection, 2D X-ray inspection, BGA rework stations, and an Aquastorm PCB wash system.

The shop serves original equipment manufacturers, Tier 1 and Tier 2 automotive suppliers, aftermarket companies, startups, and environmental-sector clients. Its assemblies are used in applications such as vehicle-to-everything (V2X) and vehicle-to-vehicle (V2V) communication systems. Customers range from global OEMs to small businesses seeking rapid prototypes or low-volume production.

SHA emphasizes personal service rooted in its family ownership, stating that a personal attachment to every board built drives superior quality and reliability. The company highlights its ability to support projects from idea through launch, offering quick-turnaround prototypes and small production runs with a focus on customer communication and flexibility.

name: Semitronics Corporation
old_description: Founded in 1952, Semitronics Corp was originally a supplier of electron tubes, which led to the distribution of electronic components in the late 50’s.
about:
Semitronics Corporation was founded in 1952 in Freeport, New York, as a supplier of electron tubes before transitioning to the distribution of electronic components in the late 1950s. The privately held company has remained under the same ownership since its inception, though the founders are not named in public records.

Today the firm operates as a hi-reliability semiconductor manufacturer, offering a full complement of products and services from wafer fabrication through final test and assembly. Its product portfolio includes MIL-PRF-19500 qualified JAN, JANTX, and JANTXV devices, along with thyristors, diodes, transistors, rectifiers, SCRs, triacs, solid-state relays, and obsolete high-reliability screened semiconductors. The company maintains a corporate headquarters in Freeport and sales branches in Dayton, Ohio, and Woburn, Massachusetts.

Semitronics serves both military and commercial markets, supplying components that meet stringent defense specifications such as MIL-PRF-19500. Customers include defense contractors and commercial electronics manufacturers requiring high-reliability semiconductors, including screened obsolete devices that are no longer in standard production.

The company emphasizes its vertically integrated capability — from wafer processing to finished device testing — as a key differentiator, enabling it to control quality across the entire manufacturing flow for high-reliability applications.

name: Semtech Corporation
old_description: Delivering high quality, innovative solutions that enable a smarter, more connected, more sustainable planet.
about:
Semtech Corporation was founded in 1960 in San Jose, California, as a manufacturer of discrete semiconductors serving military, aerospace, and industrial markets.

The company designs and manufactures a broad portfolio including transient voltage suppression (TVS) diodes, LoRa® long-range low-power wireless technology, optical networking ICs (Tri-Edge®, ClearEdge®, FiberEdge®, PON-X®) for 200G/400G/800G modules, power management, signal integrity, circuit protection (SurgeSwitch®, RailClamp®), smart sensing radar (PerSe®), broadcast video, and professional AV (BlueRiver®) solutions. Semtech reports over 280 million LoRa-enabled devices deployed worldwide.

Semtech serves industries such as Internet of Things (smart cities, agriculture, utilities, healthcare, transportation), data centers and cloud infrastructure (hyperscale, 5G, PON), automotive (electric vehicles, ADAS, Ethernet, battery management), industrial automation, broadcast, professional AV, and military/aerospace. Customers include enterprises, municipalities, telecom operators, cloud providers, and automotive OEMs.

Semtech states its purpose is to enable a smarter, more connected, and more sustainable planet through relentless innovation and adaptability. Its quality policy emphasizes ever-improving value, technically superior products, and continuous improvement, supported by ISO and military certifications and green partnerships with Sony and Canon.

name: Serán Bioscience, LLC
old_description: Serán specializes in developing versatile solid dosage forms, including capsules, tablets, and powder-in-bottle formulations, as well as a wide variety of other engineered solutions tailored for optimal in vivo exposure and scalability from discovery to clinical trials. Serán’s full investment in a shared commitment to the rapid development of better treatments that benefit patients makes us a reliable partner in your drug development journey.
about:
Serán Bioscience, LLC is a contract development and manufacturing organization (CDMO) headquartered in Bend, Oregon. Founded in 2016 by Dan Smithey, Ph.D., who serves as president and CEO, the company began as an integrated provider of drug product development, formulation, and manufacturing solutions for pharmaceutical and biotechnology clients.

The company offers a full continuum of services from preformulation and formulation development through dosage form development and cGMP manufacturing. Its capabilities span oral solid dosage forms — including capsules, tablets, powder-in-bottle, multiparticulates, and mini-tablets — as well as enabling technologies such as spray drying, hot melt extrusion, fluid bed coating, film coating, and particle size reduction via jet and nano milling. Serán operates modern development facilities and is constructing a 100,000-square-foot commercial manufacturing campus to support late-stage clinical and commercial-scale production. The team has grown to over 200 scientists, engineers, and operations staff.

Serán serves pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies advancing molecules from discovery through commercialization. Its clients rely on the firm for material-sparing prototype screening, technology selection for enabled formulations (spray drying, lipid-based systems, particle engineering), and scalable clinical manufacturing of solid oral and inhalable particulates.

The company differentiates itself through its proprietary "Right From the Start™" development paradigm, which integrates drug product intermediate and drug product development in parallel to accelerate timelines. Leadership emphasizes flexibility in unit operations, adaptable manufacturing suites, and on-site ICH stability storage as key to meeting client milestones.

name: Sessa Sheet Metal Contractors Inc
old_description: Established in 1980, Sessa Sheet Metal is an industry leader, delivering innovative, state-of-the-art sheet metal solutions to a diverse range of clients.
about:
Sessa Sheet Metal Contractors Inc. has operated from Baltimore, Maryland since its founding in 1980 by Thomas Sessa. After 16 years in the sheet metal trade, Sessa launched the company with a goal of building a 25-person operation; today it is an employee-owned business led by CEO Tom Sessa and President Bobby Sigmon.

The company provides full-service sheet metal contracting, including drafting, HVAC system analysis, estimating, and design-build project delivery. Its 32,000-square-foot fabrication shop runs a six-station coil line capable of producing 60-inch duct joints at a rate of one joint every 26 seconds, complemented by two double-table plasma machines, CNC brake bending, welding, layout, cutting, and sealing departments.

Sessa serves commercial, industrial, and institutional customers across the Mid-Atlantic region, delivering custom ductwork, fittings, and HVAC systems for projects ranging from office buildings to manufacturing plants.

The firm attributes its longevity to its employee-ownership model, which it says drives craftsmanship, safety, and long-term client relationships. Its mission emphasizes precision, professionalism, and empowering employee-owners to innovate on every project.

name: ShackletonThomas - Charles Shackleton Furniture & Miranda Thomas Pottery
old_description: Give the gift of ShackletonThomas – Gift cards now available!
about:
ShackletonThomas operates from Bridgewater, Vermont, where it was founded in 1987 by Charles Shackleton and Miranda Thomas. The two artisans established a workshop dedicated to handcrafted furniture and pottery, rooting their practice in the New England tradition of making objects by hand.

The company produces a line of furniture—including tables, barstools, and cabinets—and pottery such as mugs, bowls, vases, and serving pieces. Each item is crafted by hand in their Bridgewater Mill workshop, using natural materials such as walnut and ceramic, with details like 24‑karat gold painting on select pottery. The operation includes a retail space and studio viewing platform open to visitors several days a week. While headcount and annual volume are not disclosed, the workshop handles both standard collections and custom commissions, such as a cocktail cabinet and a drop‑leaf table documented in the company’s journal.

ShackletonThomas sells directly to consumers through its website and the Bridgewater Mill store, serving the residential furnishings and gift markets. Custom pieces have been created for private clients and hospitality settings, as illustrated by the cocktail cabinet project. The company also engages a community of followers through a newsletter and seasonal open‑house events.

The founders describe their mission as “art for living—creating unique, extraordinary pieces that have soul and life,” emphasizing that every object is made to be treasured for generations. This philosophy of handcrafted longevity distinguishes the brand in a market dominated by mass production.

name: Shaka Time Hawaii
old_description: Discover authentic Hawaiian clothing designed to bring the spirit of the islands into everyday life. At Shaka Time, we offer premium aloha wear inspired by Hawaii’s culture, color, and relaxed elegance. Since 1991, our brand has helped customers shop island-ready style with Hawaii-made clothing, timeless tropical prints, and comfortable silhouettes for men, women, and families.
about:
Shaka Time Hawaii is based in Honolulu, Hawaii, and has been operating since 1991. The company began as a brand offering authentic Hawaiian clothing crafted in Honolulu, focusing on premium aloha wear inspired by the islands' culture and relaxed elegance.

The company designs and sells a range of Hawaiian apparel including men's aloha shirts (cotton, rayon, palaka), women's dresses (short, midi, maxi, muumuu), children's clothing, matching family sets, wedding attire, accessories (leis, hair accessories, purses, jewelry), and performance socks. Products are described as Hawaii-made, with fabrics such as rayon and cotton. Shaka Time operates an e-commerce site with gift-wrapping service and free U.S. shipping on orders over $69.

Shaka Time serves individual consumers seeking vacation, luau, beach wedding, and everyday tropical wear, as well as groups and wedding parties through its group-order program. Its collections span men's, women's, and children's sizes, plus matching couples and family outfits, and even dog shirts.

The company emphasizes quality craftsmanship, island-inspired design, and genuine Hawaii-made apparel that reflects the warmth and heritage of the islands, positioning itself as a source for authentic aloha wear that combines comfort with cultural authenticity.

name: Shamrock Foods New Mexico
old_description: . She is known for her vibrant, vegetable-forward cooking, culinary creativity and deep connection to Southern California’s ingredients. Launching her culinary career at 17, she trained under top chefs and co-founded acclaimed restaurants including Playa Provisions. about:
Shamrock Foods operates from Albuquerque, New Mexico, where it has served the foodservice industry for over a century. The company is family-owned and independently operated, though the founding year and original founders are not publicly disclosed in the available materials.

The business functions as a broadline foodservice distributor, supplying fresh and frozen wholesale foods, disposable foodservice items, kitchen equipment, and related supplies to commercial kitchens. It describes itself as a one-stop shop, offering national brands alongside its own exclusive label products. Shamrock Foods ranks among the top 10 largest foodservice distributors in the United States and services customers across the Western U.S.

Its customer base spans restaurants, healthcare facilities, lodging properties, casinos and entertainment venues, and schools. Testimonials on the company's site cite operators such as Amigo's Mexican Food in Denver, the John Day/Canyon City Parks and Recreation department in Oregon, and other independent restaurant owners who rely on Shamrock for consistent product quality and delivery reliability.

Shamrock Foods emphasizes its family-owned heritage and long-term relationships as differentiators. It also provides a digital resource hub called Kitchentelligence, offering culinary inspiration, menu trends, and operational advice from its team of culinary professionals. The company highlights exclusive brands, rebate programs, and a cash-and-carry warehouse option as additional value drivers for operators.

name: Shawhan Sheet Metal, LLC
old_description: Shawhan Sheet Metal has been fabricating and installing quality sheet metal products in the Kansas City area since 2004. With over 70 years of combined experience, we manage a large variety of projects from simple gutter systems to large-scale architectural metal systems.
about:
Shawhan Sheet Metal, LLC, based in Independence, Missouri, has been fabricating and installing sheet metal products in the Kansas City area since 2004. The woman-owned company is led by CEO Mary Shawhan and draws on over 70 years of combined staff experience across architectural sheet metal projects.

The firm provides full-service architectural envelope solutions, from design coordination and estimating through shop drawing, laser scanning, 3D modeling, and custom in-house fabrication. Its shop produces standing seam metal roofs, composite panel (ACM) systems, custom copper gutters, and commercial gutter systems, with capabilities including MIG/TIG welding, punching, cutting, routing, drilling, tapping, and threading. Installation crews hold OSHA 10- and 30-hour certifications.

Shawhan serves retail, commercial, and corporate identity clients, working with architects, owners, and general contractors on new construction and historic restoration projects. Notable projects include General MacArthur Elementary, the Artistry development, Surgicenter, Mazda, Well Sky, and the T-Mobile Center.

The company differentiates itself through technology integration—its in-house laser scanner captures as-built conditions to generate fabrication drawings, reducing lead times—and by offering a single-source provider model that spans design, fabrication, and installation.

name: Sheet Metal Contracting Company
old_description: Sheet Metal Contracting Co., Inc. is a custom metal fabrication company that manufacturers primarily for the industrial and commercial fields. Whether your project is hundreds to thousands of parts or just a one item prototype, we have the machine capabilities and staff with the knowledge to get your job done efficiently and accurately. With our wide range of machines we're able to CNC cut, bend, punch, machine and weld any specifications you may have. Conveniently located in northern Delaware, we work closely with your engineers and designers to complete your projects.
about:
Sheet Metal Contracting Company, Inc. traces its roots to 1910 when Ruben I. Hutt opened an inventor’s shop at 218½ French Street in Wilmington, Delaware. The family-owned business moved to its current 24,000‑square‑foot facility on Wrangle Hill Road in Bear in 1978 after Hutt sold the operation to Bob Bupp and Howard Banning. Today the company is led by owner Jeff Bupp and a small team of fabrication specialists.

The shop provides custom metal fabrication — CNC cutting, bending, punching, machining, and welding — for projects ranging from single prototypes to runs of thousands of parts. Its equipment lineup handles materials from standard hot‑rolled steel through rare alloys and stainless grades, as well as plastics. The facility sits along the I‑95 corridor, allowing quick access to Delaware, Maryland, Pennsylvania, and New Jersey.

Core markets include the chemical, energy, textile, and agriculture sectors. Long‑standing customers include DuPont, W.L. Gore, and Siemens, alongside regional machine shops and contractors. Finished work ships throughout North America and overseas.

The company emphasizes fabrication expertise honed over more than a century, offering design and engineering assistance to meet exact specifications with swift turnaround times.
